Cursor 内置 skill 只读，不能修改。: Cursor built-in skills are read-only and cannot be modified.
Skill Hub 会读取并管理这些文件夹里的 skills 和 prompts: Skill Hub reads and manages the skills and prompts in these folders. They all live in your home directory, so you only need to grant access once.
Skill Hub 的 prompt 库和归档: Skill Hub prompt library and archive
Skill Hub 需要读写 %@ 下的 .cursor、.claude、.co: Skill Hub needs to read and write the .cursor, .claude, .codex and .agents folders under %@. Your home folder is already selected — just click “Grant”.
一句话说明什么时候用它: One sentence on when to use it
会删掉实体目录，并清掉指向它的符号链接。: Deletes the real folder and removes the symlinks pointing to it.
先授权访问你的主目录: Grant access to your home folder first
只会删掉链接 %@，真实目录保留。: Only the link %@ is removed; the real folder stays.
只留实体目录，删掉其余符号链接: Keep the real folder, remove the other symlinks
可以留空，稍后再编辑: Can be left empty and edited later
同一份文件出现在多个工具目录，所以算重复安装。: The same files appear in several tool folders, so this counts as a duplicate install.
同名但不是同一个文件夹，内容可能已经不一样了。重复安装只算同一份的多个链接。: Same name but a different folder, so the contents may have drifted. “Duplicate install” only means several links to one folder.
Names may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The description goes into the SKILL.md frontmatter; agents use it to decide when to load the skill.
名字只能用小写字母、数字和连字符，最多 64 个字符。: Names may only use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 64 characters.
回到当前分类的气泡图: Back to this filter’s bubble map
复制后两边各自独立，修改不会同步。: After copying the two are independent; edits do not sync.
复制成独立实体，而不是符号链接: Copy as an independent folder instead of a symlink
实体会移到 ~/.skill-hub/archive，各工具里的符号链接会被移除: The folder moves to ~/.skill-hub/archive and the symlinks in each tool are removed.
将删除 %@。如果这是最后一份实体，其他工具里的链接也会失效。: %@ will be deleted. If it is the last real copy, links in other tools will break.
已另存到独立库: Saved a copy to the library
已经装到所有可写的工具里了。: Already installed in every writable tool.
按名称前缀聚类 · Skills 和 Prompts: Clustered by name prefix · Skills and Prompts
按调用：调用次数多的在前；按最近：最近用过的在前，长期没用的沉底: Calls: most-called first. Recent: most recently used first, long-unused sink to the bottom
授权只保存在这台 Mac 上，随时可以在「文件 › 重新授权主目录…」里更改。: The grant is stored only on this Mac and can be changed any time under File › Re-authorize Home Folder…
有 %lld 个 skill 同时出现在多个工具目录里。选择保留哪一份，其余会被: %lld skills appear in more than one tool folder. Choose which copy to keep; the rest are removed. Cursor’s built-in folder is read-only and is never touched.
气泡大小按使用频率：agent 调用次数、收藏、装到几个工具。同名前缀会合并成一: Bubble size follows usage: agent calls, stars and how many tools it is installed in. Shared name prefixes merge into a group; open one to drill down.
没有拿到主目录的访问权限。请在「文件 › 重新授权主目录…」里重新授权。: No access to the home folder. Re-authorize under File › Re-authorize Home Folder…
点气泡打开一类或一项 · 点中心重新排列: Click a bubble to open a group or item · click the centre to reshuffle
用工具栏里的「新建」创建一个，或者换一个筛选条件。: Create one with “New” in the toolbar, or pick another filter.
符号链接指回同一个目录，在任何工具里修改都是同一份文件。推荐。: A symlink points back to the same folder, so edits in any tool touch the same files. Recommended.
继续点气泡往下，或点中心返回上一层: Keep clicking bubbles to drill down, or click the centre to go up
超过 %lld 天没被调用: Not called for more than %lld days
路径不在允许的根目录内：%@: Path is outside the allowed roots: %@
输入标签，按回车添加: Type a tag and press Return
返回上一层，或换一个分类。: Go up one level or pick another filter.
这个文件会从磁盘上删除。: This file will be deleted from disk.
这是最后一份实体文件，不能只当作链接移除。: This is the last real copy; it cannot be removed as if it were a link.
这是最后一份实体文件，删除后无法从工具目录恢复。指向它的符号链接会一并清掉。: This is the last real copy; once deleted it cannot be recovered from the tool folders. Symlinks pointing to it are removed too.
选择主目录并授权: Choose home folder and grant access
需要选择你的用户主目录 %@，而不是 %@。: Please choose your home folder %1$@, not %2$@.
